warrant: The graded histories and frames follow the special-relativistic electrostatic path: relativistic streaming and acceleration with the Maxwell field solve in 1x1v. In `rt_vlasov_sr_twostream_1x1v.c`, `alpha` (line 77) is the amplitude of the seed perturbation; the two-ULP variant therefore moves every graded value at the level of the arithmetic, while a wrong relativistic velocity, a wrong current or a wrong field update changes them at order one. The bound atol=1e-10, rtol=1e-10 was set on 2026-09-06 from the calibration selfcheck on the x86 worker 136.114.2.6 (1 cpu, 4 GB, Docker): the two-ULP variant used at most 1.7e-3 of it and the strict-IEEE altbuild at most 8.2e-3 (worst files `elc-imom.gkyl` and `field-energy.gkyl`), a headroom of about 123x over the larger legitimate perturbation, while the faults named above move the graded values at order one.
